Name: Single Tip Pentalobe Screwdriver
Description: Screwdriver is designed for iPhones and has a fixed tip so it can only remove one specific size of screw

Name: Replaceable Tip Pentalobe Screwdriver
Description: Screwdriver type has replaceable tip that can be swapped between multiple sizes of screws and screw types for a single screwdriver. Has pentalobe for iPhone screws

Description: This screwdriver has a replaceable tip and is racheting. So the tip can be swapped out and it lets you drive screws twice as fast by allowing for continuous twisting motion. The pentalobe head is designed for iPhone screws

Name: Precision Flat Head Screwdriver
Description: Screwdriver has fixed head and is meant for small flat head screws

Name: Precision Phillips Head Screwdriver
Description: Screwdriver has fixed head and is meant for small Phillips head screws
